services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-usd
services.description: Bitcoin price in USD. Current BTC-USD rate and sats per USD from a public source. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: mempool-feerate
services.description: Bitcoin mempool fee rates. Sat/vB bands for fast, medium, and slow confirmation. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: mempool-backlog
services.description: Bitcoin mempool backlog. Transaction count, virtual size, and total fee. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: fee-for-vsize
services.description: Fee in sats for a given virtual size. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: confirm-target
services.description: Map a confirmation wait time or band to sat/vB. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-invoice-decode
services.description: Parse a Lightning BOLT11 invoice. Returns amount, expiry, and payee. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-invoice-preflight
services.description: Check whether a Lightning invoice is safe to pay. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-path-fee-hint
services.description: First-path fee hint from the operator LND. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-address-validate
services.description: Check a Bitcoin address. Returns network and type, or a short reason if invalid. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-fee-estimate
services.description: Bitcoin Core estimatesmartfee for 1, 3, and 6 blocks, in sats per vbyte. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-chain-status
services.description: Bitcoin Core chain height, sync progress, and prune state from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-network-info
services.description: Bitcoin Core version, protocol, and connection counts from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-mempool-info
services.description: Bitcoin Core mempool size, memory, and minimum fee from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-peer-info
services.description: Bitcoin Core peer count and a short address list from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-difficulty
services.description: Bitcoin Core difficulty, chainwork, and blocks until the next retarget from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-block-tip
services.description: Bitcoin Core tip height, block hash, and median time from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-block-header
services.description: Bitcoin Core block header for one height from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-address-balance
services.description: Bitcoin Core confirmed UTXO balance for one address from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-uptime
services.description: Bitcoin Core uptime and version from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-mempool-fees
services.description: Bitcoin Core mempool minimum fee and fee bands from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: btc-chain-tips
services.description: Bitcoin Core chain tips from the operator bitcoind. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-invoice-inspect
services.description: LND decode of one BOLT11 invoice. Read-only. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-path-estimate
services.description: LND route estimate for one destination. Does not pay. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: nostr-node-link
services.description: Public Nostr npub and whether it matches this node's Lightning id. No nsec. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: nip05-verify
services.description: Check a NIP-05 name against an npub. No nsec. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: nostr-profile-summary
services.description: Short public Nostr profile summary. No nsec and no nip05 check. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: event-verify
services.description: Check a Nostr event id and signature locally. No relay. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: npub-decode
services.description: Decode a Nostr npub, note, nprofile, or nevent to hex. Rejects nsec. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-preimage-verify
services.description: SHA-256 check that a preimage matches a payment hash. No LND. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-pay-check
services.description: Decide whether one invoice or destination is payable. Does not pay. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-address-resolve
services.description: Read a Lightning address pay range. Does not request an invoice. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-route-options
services.description: LND route options for one destination. Does not pay. Lightning L402.

services.name: agent-bitcoin: ln-invoice-amount-check
services.description: LND check of whether an invoice amount is open or fixed. Read-only. Lightning L402.
